videos.caption: 🍫 Classic Dubai Chocolate Ingredients: * 200 g milk chocolate * 100 g kataifi (shredded phyllo pastry) * 20 g butter * 120 g pistachio cream * 1 tbsp tahini * 1 pinch of salt Method: 1. Melt the chocolate     Melt the milk chocolate gently until completely smooth. 2. Make the chocolate shell     Pour some melted chocolate into the mold and spread it across the bottom and sides. Make sure the shell is thick enough so it won’t break. Refrigerate for 10–15 minutes. 3. Prepare the kataifi     Cut the kataifi into smaller pieces. Melt the butter in a pan, add the kataifi and fry over medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 4. Make the pistachio filling     Let the toasted kataifi cool slightly. Mix it with the pistachio cream, tahini and a pinch of salt until everything is evenly combined. 5. Fill the chocolate     Spoon the pistachio-kataifi mixture into the chocolate shell. Press it down gently and spread it evenly, leaving a little space around the edges. 6. Seal the chocolate     Pour the remaining melted chocolate over the filling and spread it into a smooth layer, completely sealing the chocolate. 7. Chill     Refrigerate for 20–30 minutes, or until completely firm. 8. Enjoy!     Remove from the mold, break or cut it open and enjoy that crispy pistachio filling! 💚🍫 #easyrecipe #recipe #foodtok #asmrchocolate #asmr

🇸🇪Kladdkaka: easy, quick, gooey, and fantastic chocolate cake! ⬇️⬇️ This is Frederiksfika’s recipe for Kladdkaka, endorsed by IKEA themselves: Ingredients: 200g butter 270g sugar 60g cocoa powder 1/2 tsp salt 3 eggs 90g all purpose flour  A 7-9 inch cake pan (mine is 8) Method: -Preheat oven to 175c/350f and line the pan with parchment, grease the sides  -Melt the butter over low heat, remove from heat -In the same pot, whisk in the sugar, salt, and cocoa until well combined -Whisk in the eggs, one at a time -Fold in flour until fully combined -Pour into pan and bake on the middle rack for 18-25 minutes. Cake should wobble in the center. You can take it out at 18 for a very gooey center but I went for around 23 minutes to get a gooey and dense but not wet center  -Enjoy! #cake #kladdkaka  #internationalfood #ikea

videos.caption: I just wanted to bake chocolate lava cakes... Instead Evelyn cracked me, in more way than one. 🥀🍫😭 #househusbandbakes #evelynchevalier #evelynzzz #animecouplegoals #animetok  This recipe makes 4 chocolate lava cakes.  Ingredients:  • 1/2 cup (4 ounces) unsalted butter, plus more for greasing the ramekins • 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting the ramekins • 6 ounces bittersweet or dark chocolate, chopped (about 1 cup plus 1 1/2 tablespoons) You can sub in chocolate chips if its all you have. • 2 large eggs, room temperature • 2 large egg yolks, room temperature • 1/4 cup granulated sugar • 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt Directions:  Gather the ingredients. ● Preheat oven to 450°F. Butter and lightly flour four 6-ounce ramekins. Tap out excess flour. Set the ramekins on a baking sheet. ● Fill a pan/pot with water to a depth of 1 or 2 Inches depending on the depth of the pot; bring to a boil over medium-high and reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a simmer. Combine chocolate and butter in a medium size heatproof bowl and set bowl over simmering water in pan, making sure bottom of bowl doesn't touch water. Cook over medium-low, stirring occasionally and adjusting heat as needed to maintain a simmer, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. ● Beat eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl with an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment on high speed until thickened and pale, 2 to 3 minutes ● Whisk melted chocolate until smooth ● Quickly fold melted chocolate mixture and flour into egg mixture in bowl until well combined and no streaks remain. ● Spoon batter into prepared ramekins (about 1/2 cup per ramekin) and smooth the top using a small offset spatula if needed. Place baking sheet with ramekins in the preheated oven; bake until tops of cakes are just set and edges spring back when touched but centers still feel soft, about 9 to 12 minutes. ● Remove cakes from oven and let cool in ramekins on baking sheet for 1 minute. Working with one ramekin at a time, cover ramekin with an inverted plate. Carefully turn over and let stand 10 seconds before lifting the ramekin to unmold cake. Repeat with remaining cakes. Dust with powdered sugar if you want the dominos pizza lavs cake look. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days. Microwave briefly to reheat.

Chocolate collections in these sets are inspired by the exquisite perfume compositions of the twentieth century and dedicated to a talented young perfumer lady, who gifted the world with these remarkable fragrances. The miniature perfume bottles are crafted using familiar bonbons molds. The compositions adorning the chocolate bars are hand-painted with cocoa butter directly on the mold, as well as on delicate sheets of acetate film carefully placed on top of the chocolate bars. Thanks to this meticulous approach, each piece in the collection is imbued with a special mood, as if it preserves within itself fragrant stories from the last century. ⠀ . ⠀ Шоколадные коллекции данных наборов, вдохновлены изысканными парфюмерными композициями XX века и посвещены талантливой девушке-парфюмеру, подарившей миру эти удивительные ароматы. Миниатюрные флакончики для духов реализованны с помощью привычных форм для конфет. Композиции, которыми украшены  шоколадные плитки, нарисованы вручную какао-маслом прямо на молде, а также на тонкой ацетатной пленке, аккуратно размещённой поверх шоколадных плиток. Благодаря этому каждый экземпляр коллекции пронизан особым настроением, словно хранит внутри ароматные истории прошлого столетия. ⠀ . ⠀ #bonbonchocolat #chocolatebonbon#конфетыручнойработы #конфетыназаказ #корпусныеконфеты #шоколад #artchocolate#edibleart#handpainted#шоколадныйподарок#chocolatebonbons #chocolate#бельгийскийшоколад #шоколадручнойработы #callebaut#callebautchocolate#
